summary: Impressive endurance completing 56 push-ups across four sets separated by downward-dog rests. The first 25-30 reps show strong plank alignment, good depth, and a brisk rhythm. As fatigue sets in (especially during the third set, reps 41-50), core stability breaks down: the hips sag while the chest presses up first (snaking/upward-dog motion) and then pike high at the top. Focus on bracing the core and glutes to keep the torso and hips rising as a single rigid unit, and keep the neck neutral by looking at the floor slightly ahead of the hands.
